s: In which year did B. N. Sharma move the resolution?
x:
B. N. Sharma moved the resolution in 1917 supporting the creation of a separate Andhra Province. The resolution marked an important milestone in the Andhra movement because it transformed the demand for a separate province into a formal political objective. It also reflected the growing awareness of linguistic identity among Telugu-speaking people.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
